units.source_text: 开往敦贺的列车，从京都站发车时间是上午6点55分。

en.t: The train bound for Tsuruga leaves Kyoto Station at 6:55 in the morning.
The temple's wake-up time is five-thirty.

units.source_text: 10日早晨，我一起床马上换上制服，没有引起任何人的怀疑。

en.t: On the morning of the tenth, as soon as I got up, I changed into my uniform without arousing anyone's suspicion.

units.source_text: 因为他们都习惯对我视而不见。

en.t: Because they were all used to looking right past me.
